_comment: Timing parameters for multilink_sim.py. Every value has a 'source'. Values marked PLACEHOLDER must be replaced by measurements (plan.md W4) before numbers go into the paper.

core.source: scripts/find_fmax_ooc.tcl, ascon_aead_array K=1 (current RTL), xc7z020clg400-1, Vivado 2023.2, post-route: 3.550 ns met (WNS +0.101 ns). K=2/4/8: 277.8/281.7/274.0 MHz. Re-run on 2026.1.
core.cycles: 14 + 9*(N-1) + (1 if AD) + 14, N = AD blocks + PT blocks (RTL-verified, tb_encypt / tb_decrypt)

stream.description: Data streamed to the core (AXI-Stream / DMA), 32-bit words at fclk; transfers of different cores overlap.

axilite.description: CPU drives the AXI4-Lite registers of ascon_aead_axi_multi; one bus shared by all cores.
axilite.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical Zynq-7000 GP0 MMIO access from C; measure on PYNQ-Z1 (W4)

a9_c.description: Ascon-AEAD128 C reference on the Cortex-A9 (PYNQ-Z1 PS, 650 MHz)
a9_c.source: PLACEHOLDER: measure encrypt/decrypt per message type on PYNQ-Z1 (W4)

esp32_tinyjambu_prior.description: Prior work (ESP32, TinyJAMBU, software), per message
esp32_tinyjambu_prior.source: jonarta2023securing, Table II rows 5-6 of the current draft

link.description: Per-UAV radio link (one channel per UAV)
link.source: assumption: 2 Mbps telemetry/C2 radio, 1 ms base delay

gateway.source: assumption: packet handling per message at the GCS / gateway, excluding crypto

uav.source: assumption: packet handling per message on the UAV, excluding crypto
